# Notion Skills API renderings (fixtures)

Revision: 0.1.33 · Updated: 2026-11-05

`*.notion.txt` are the SKILL.md files returned by the Notion Skills API for four public Factory
skills, read on 5 November 2026: factory-review (released reference 0.1.18), factory-foundation
(0.1.31), factory-agent-ops and factory-entry (0.1.32). `*.portable.txt` are the reviewed portable exports of the
same revisions; `*.previous.txt` are the earlier exports (agent-ops 0.1.29, entry 0.1.23), used for link-text and list-style hints.
Test data only; the Notion pages remain the originals.
